notes.title: Pause Function Added and Game-Over Animations Enhanced
notes.content:
Thank you so much for playing Hatch!

The following updates have been applied:
[list]
[*] You can now pause the game using the ESC key or the Start button.
[*] Settings can now be changed in-game.
[*] Adjustments have been made to the game-over animations when caught by the enemy.
[*] The display of control keys has been improved, making it easier to progress through the game.
[*] Other minor adjustments have also been made.
[/list]
I would appreciate your opinions and feedback on your gameplay experience in reviews or similar.

notes.title: Enemy AI enhancements and multi-language support
notes.content:
Thank you so much for playing Hatch!

This update brings several improvements:
[list]
[*] New language support: Traditional Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish (Spain and Latin America), Russian, Portuguese (Brazil), Thai, Polish, and Turkish.
[*] Enhanced enemy AI roaming for better game balance.
[*] New option to select a centrally expanding stealth gauge.
[*] Fixed gamepad control issues.
[*] Additional minor tweaks for an improved experience.
[/list]
I'd appreciate hearing your thoughts and feedback on your gaming experience.

notes.title: Added Chinese support, improved visuals, and fixed bugs.
notes.content:
Thank you sincerely for playing Hatch!

This update brings several improvements:

[list]
[*] Support for Simplified Chinese has been added.
[*] Full compatibility with Korean has been achieved.
[*] Environmental lighting is more realistic, thanks to enhanced lightmap resolution.
[*] The quality of meshes and textures in certain objects has been improved.
[*] Additional variations of jump scare animations have been introduced.
[*] The option to toggle motion blur on or off is now available.
[*] Selectable anti-aliasing is introduced for a smoother visual experience.
[*] A bug allowing item duplication has been fixed.
[*] Various other bug fixes have been implemented, optimizing game performance.
[/list]

Your feedback and thoughts on the game experience would be greatly appreciated.
